jobs.description:
PRO360 is an access portal for Bosch Professional services.
Users can register once to enjoy benefits, such as extending their tool warranty from 1 to 3 years.
I am part of one of the feature teams, which includes 3 frontend developers, myself included.
Our work focuses primarily on redesigning and enhancing existing features, while also adding new ones, in the webapp and mobile app.
